name: Coldseam Tier-Hop Courier's Full Transit Set
description:
Built for someone who moves between Tier 1 and Tier 4 in a single shift. The base is a fitted long-sleeve in neutral heather grey with sealed neural port collar — unremarkable at every checkpoint. Over it, a reversible shell jacket: one side matte olive with cargo pockets and a hood, the other side clean charcoal with a minimal structured collar that reads professional. Pants are tapered dark navy with hidden zip pockets and articulated knees. Shoes are a sleek low-profile runner in dark grey, clean enough for a Tier 4 lobby, durable enough for Shelf transit.

A compact sling pack in waxed black nylon with RFID-blocking inner lining and false-bottom compartment completes the set. The whole kit compresses to bag-size. Every piece is chosen to read differently depending on which side of the jacket faces out.
functionality: Reversible jacket for rapid tier-presentation shift, RFID-blocking sling pack with false-bottom compartment, neural port collar access, articulated knees for active transit, full outfit compresses for concealed carry.
what_it_says: I belong wherever I need to be, and by the time you figure out I don't, I'm already gone.
story_hooks: The false-bottom compartment of the sling pack currently contains a sealed data chip addressed to someone who died two weeks ago.
A Tier 4 building's facial recognition flagged the courier — not for a crime, but because their face matches a Spire family's missing-person file from eleven years ago.
The reversible jacket's charcoal side has a small embroidered mark inside the collar — a symbol that opens a door in the Shelf that shouldn't exist.
